items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: we got Tommy Dorsey to come over from Detroit and he brought and he brought Jimmy McGregor with him... I sent my drums over to Detroit so we could rehearse the band and uh with Jeremy McGregor and Bill Elastic and Tommy Dorsey and myself

ctx.x: I'm at Ray Badouk's house and today is the 27th of June 1984 and we're looking at a picture of his brother's band. Jules Badouk. Yeah and it's got the date on the front 8-4-28 that's 1928 huh? yeah and and it's got the names on the back so let's turn it over and I'll read them all to you. Horace Diaz, piano, Doc Rando, clarinet and alto, sax. Mike Lala, second trumpet, played jazz. Harry McKeown, first trumpet, Jules Badouk, banjo and lita. Paul Piquet, first alto sax. Eddie Nacken is the drummer. Oscar Marko,…

left left left to go up north. That was about 1926. That's when johnny well and it was I was still with johnny I was still with Johnny Beisdolph and we collaborated with Billy Lustig and made it for Scranton Sirens and went to Chicago, see? Well, at the finish of the Chicago job at the Rendezvous, it was a gambling place. At the finish of that, Tommy Dorsey had come over from Detroit. And Chum and McGregor was with him because, I can't think of his name, our piano player, his mother was sick and he had to go back…
So you, well, you'd come back for a visit though, on vacation or something.
